title: Minneapolis Holiday Lights Trolley Ride
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: An all-ages Christmas lights adventure that starts and ends at the historic Pillsbury Club, where families can explore a holiday market with local vendors and enjoy special child pricing for an affordable outing. The 1.25-hour trolley tour covers beautiful Minneapolis light displays, and riders get to judge and rank the stops to help crown the city’s fan-favorite home. It’s a bright, family-friendly experience designed for holiday fun, easy shopping, and shared seasonal magic.
